text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This paper is an empirical economic analysis focusing on the efficiency and cost of renewable energy policy design for onshore wind energy in Germany. It does not involve land use/land cover (LULC) future prediction or spatial modeling of LULC changes as a primary or secondary focus. The spatial aspects considered relate to wind turbine siting and energy generation efficiency, not LULC prediction. There is no implementation of multiple future LULC scenarios or quantitative accuracy metrics related to LULC. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criteria for LULC prediction studies and is excluded.)
